cards.front: Revision surgery is scheduled for a patient with an anterior discectomy and fusion for cervical radiculopathy . Previous approach was on the left side . Patient has residual, asymptomatic left recurrent laryngeal nerve injury . Should the approach for the revision surgery be right or left? Left
cards.extra: If revision surgery is planned from the opposite side, the vocal cords need to be evaluated with laryngoscopy preoperatively. If there was asymptomatic (left) RLN injury from the initial surgery, then the opposite side approach is inadvisable for fear of developing bilateral vocal cord paralysis and its catastrophic complications.
